visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young male with styled black hair and a black tank top is shown in a medium close-up, sitting in front of a grey tiled wall. He holds chopsticks with a piece of egg and looks skeptically at a healthy bento box. (2) A young female with glasses and long black hair is shown eating a large Zongzi (rice dumpling) from a plate. She wears a white t-shirt and looks happy, chewing with her mouth full. (3) The male character returns, pointing his chopsticks and lecturing while holding his healthy bento. (4) The camera shows a close-up of the female's arm being shaken by the male, then a close-up of the top of her head (scalp). (5) The male holds up a white dumbbell and a chicken breast slice while talking energetically. (6) The female expresses frustration while holding her Zongzi. (7) A product sachet of GAIA Vegan Protein is shown with a dynamic graphic transition. (8) The male throws several sachets towards the female who is lounging on a white beanbag chair looking at her phone. (9) Product focus: three different flavored sachets (Chocolate, Coffee, Matcha) are displayed with moving backgrounds. (10) The female mixes the powder into a gold MARS shaker and drinks it, appearing satisfied. (11) A close-up shows the chocolate-colored liquid being poured into a glass with a splash effect. (12) The male is seen against a vibrant green and purple graphic background, holding a shaker and drinking. (13) Both characters are seated together, laughing and holding shakers, with protein product boxes and sachets on the table. (14) Final screen displays the GAIA brand logo and slogan.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Fast-paced upbeat electronic BGM begins. Male voice (Baxuan) starts speaking in an assertive, high-arousal instructional tone, lecturing about health. (2) Vocal shift to female voice with a cheerful, casual tone, accompanied by rhythmic chewing sounds. (3) Sharp 'whoosh' transition SFX marks the product introduction. (4) Male narrator continues with a professional, energetic broadcasting delivery describing product specs, mixed with digital 'ding' and 'pop' UI sound effects. (5) SFX of liquid pouring and a 'splash' transient occur as the protein is mixed. (6) High-pitched female exclamation 'Wah~' of excitement. (7) Closing sequence features synchronized laughter from both characters, ending with a soft musical fade out.

It emphasizes the taste and high protein content of the product.
